data.long_meaning: The one who keeps others awake at night, or the one who is restless and anxious. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Nawaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody restless and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: نَواز
in_arabic.long_meaning: النَواز مشتق من ن-و-ز، في اللغة العربية يعني يمنح أو يعطي بكرم و سخاء. وردت هذه المعاني في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن كرم الله وإنعامهِ على عباده. تاريخياً، كان اسم نواز يطلق على الشخص الكريم السخي الذي يتصف بالجود و الإكثار من العطاء.

in_urdu.name: نواز
in_urdu.meaning: نواز: دینے والا، عطا کرنے والا، شفقت کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نواز کا مطلب ہے نو-و-ز جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے دینا یا عطا کرنا۔ اسلامی روایت میں، نواز ایک ایسے شخص کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنی سخاوت اور شفقت کے لئے جانا جاتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان، یہ نام اچھے اخلاق اور كريم طبع کے لئے استعمال کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नवाज़
in_hindi.meaning: नवाज़: देने वाला, प्रदान करने वाला, दयालु
in_hindi.long_meaning: नवाज़ नाम की उत्पत्ति न-व-ज़ जड़ से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है देना या प्रदान करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, नवाज़ नाम का उपयोग एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए किया जाता है जो अपनी उदारता और दयालुता के लिए जाना जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अच्छे चरित्र और उदार स्वभाव के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نواز
in_pashto.meaning: نواز: ورکړه کوونکی، ډالۍ ورکوونکی، مهربان
in_pashto.long_meaning: نواز د ن-و-ز ريښې څخه مشتق دی، کوم چې په پښتو کې د ورکړې یا ډالۍ ورکولو معنی لري. په پښتني دود کې، نواز د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چې د خپل کرم او شفقت له امله مشهور دی. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې، دا نوم د ښو اخلاقو او کريم طبع لپاره کارول شوی دی.

in_english.name: Nawaaz
in_english.meaning: One who gives, bestows, or shows kindness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nawaaz originates from the Arabic root 'n-w-z', which means 'to give' or 'to bestow'. This name is associated with attributes of generosity, kindness, and compassion. In Islamic tradition, Nawaaz is used to describe a person known for their charitable nature and benevolence. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person with noble character and a giving spirit.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name "Nawaaz" holds a unique yet poignant meaning. It is derived from the Arabic word "na'a" which means "to keep awake" or "to keep alert." In the context of Islamic society, the name "Nawaaz" is often given to a child born during the holy month of Ramadan. During this month, Muslims fast from dawn to sunset and dedicate themselves to meaningful prayer, study, reflection, and charitable acts. A child born during this holy month is seen as a blessing and a source of joy to the family. The name "Nawaaz" is a reminder that just as Muslims are called to stay awake and alert during the month, the child named after this concept might also grow up with a deep sense of responsibility and commitment towards Islam and their community.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name "Nawaaz" embodies the idea of being awake and alert not only to the physical realities of life but also to the spiritual realities that surround us. It is a reminder of the spiritual awakening that comes from a deep sense of connection with God and His teachings. The name could serve as a daily reminder for the person named after it to live a purposeful life, dedicated to learning, self-improvement, and service to others. Ultimately, the name "Nawaaz" can inspire a sense of restlessness in pursuing spiritual growth and a reminder to stay grounded in the presence of God, no matter the circumstances of life.
